title: Does anyone have any tips for setting up Godot with Astra properly?
author: Kiko_Production
selftext:
I’m trying to get Godot working smoothly with Astra, but I’m not sure what the best setup/workflow is.

If anyone here uses them together, I’d really appreciate any tips, recommended settings, or things I should avoid.

comments.author: 3tt07kjt
comments.body:
Ask Astra

Models are generally very familiar with their own capabilities, and they’ll also do web searches to find popular MCPs or whatnot

replies.author: Kiko_Production
replies.body: I completely forgot about the simplest way) be sure to try it

comments.author: MHZ-Dev
comments.body: Someone mentioned on my post to use it with VSCode or any other IDE you can have Astra on. I recommend learning about the nodes etc yourself and letting Astra just handle the coding. If you get stuck on nodes you can just ask Astra to explain what nodes. This setup allowed me to learn Godot as I went along very quickly.

replies.author: Kiko_Production
replies.body: Interesting, so the task of  setting up the atlases is on me? Which problematic nodes does Astra struggle with the most?

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: I'm not sure what you mean. Do you want Astra to control Godot? I don't have any experience with that. More just using it to write the code/scripts and guide me on set ups etc.

comments.author: WorkAccountObv
comments.body:
I typically just copy the downloaded copy of the Godot docs and put it in my project folder and add a line in agents md to use it. 

I also ask it to apply best practices in the agents md, signal up, call down and static typing being the main two. When it comes to gameplay tuning etc I have Astra build editable scenes that can be launched and adjusted which I can then paste back in values into Astra as gameplay defaults.

replies.author: Kiko_Production
replies.body: Sounds great, definitely will try it! Thx!

comments.author: OverProgrammer3210
comments.body: I use Codex via the ChatGPT Windows app. I asked it to guide me in setting it up. It has access to my desktop so I don’t have to upload any files or download any zips to test my game.

replies.author: Kiko_Production
replies.body: Wow, what is a hidden gem! Will try it!
